metadata.description: Named areas used across the corpus: counties, cities, neighbourhoods, ZIP codes, water districts and pressure zones, evacuation zones, census tracts, patrol beats.
metadata.extents: Boxes are honest approximations: each says how it was derived in extent_basis. None is a legal or postal boundary. Use reference_point for placement and bbox only as a search window.
metadata.coordinates: Coordinates are real published points (reference/geo/landmarks.geojson) or points beside real roads; see position_basis on each record and reference/geo/SOURCES_*.md.
